contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::calculateScore(): Integer {
	definition:
		currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequest
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentLoanRequest.RequestedCAHistory.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentLoanRequest.RequestedCreditHistory.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		currentLoanRequest.CreditScore = 100 and
		currentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED and
		result = 100
}
